title: Captured Android touchpad MotionEvent SOURCE_MOUSE needs InputDevice.getSources SOURCE_TOUCHPAD
hypothesis: Normally an Android trackpad reports MotionEvent.getSource=SOURCE_MOUSE=8194 while its InputDevice.getSources includes SOURCE_TOUCHPAD=1048584; event-only Classify previously ignored those captured relative-axis packets.

implementation.description: Keeps one-argument Classify for historic regression and adds Classify(eventSource,deviceSources) with source=SOURCE_MOUSE and device touchpad capability both necessary.

For captured SOURCE_MOUSE only, reads InputEvent.getDevice().getSources with scoped disposed JNI wrapper, passes both sources to classifier; touches/screens/uncaptured events return to original Unity.
3 new native JNI source guards and updated legacy assertion for correct two-argument classification.
Runs all source policies including 5 previously unexecuted scheduled T4 physical mouse presence assertions inside existing isolated original ABI CI.

controls: Ordinary SOURCE_MOUSE with only mouse device sources is not accepted as touchpad.
Event SOURCE_TOUCHSCREEN stays ignored even if composite device advertises touchpad.
SOURCE_MOUSE_RELATIVE uses the existing relative Mouse.getX/Y with no additional getDevice JNI lookup.
InputDevice.getSources read only if event source is SOURCE_MOUSE; missing device conservatively ignored.
AndroidJavaObject device wrapper disposed with using and callback old-generation token remains checked under captureGate.
Scheduled T4 legacy Input.mousePresent exclusion and virtual RaftAndroidTouchLeft exclusion remain unchanged.
No Android touch injection, gameplay, original .rgd, shader, UI or Settings changes.
initial_ci_failures: Intermediate runs 42144331049 and 42144368616 failed because an old static assertion still required single-argument Classify(source); corrected to require Classify(source, deviceSources) at commit f0e6cfd6. Final full CI PASS.
limitations: Android official API classification proves former touchpad branch misses usual events, not that a touchpad was used on this device.
Native JNI, real Unity IL2CPP Android player and actual captured pointer hardware tests have not run.
Unknown/missing InputDevice falls back to original Unity handling; intentional fail-open.
Actual camera sensitivity, touchpad vendor differences, Android OS black cursor/bars, buttons/wheel, T5 Resolution and .rgd world/save/reopen require signed device regression.
next_step: On T5-coordinated signed source candidate verify device trackpad SOURCE_MOUSE with actual getSources touchpad capability; captured AXIS_RELATIVE_X/Y accumulation, physical USB mouse, frequent game/menu/reenter, OS pointer and bars, keyboard/wheel/touch, and local playable world/save/exit/reopen. Do not claim READY or close INPUT-005.
